feats.name: Hearthborn
feats.excerpt: Hit Point maximum +1 per character level.
feats.text:
You grew up beside a forge and shrug off hardship.

**Hardy.** Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1 for each character level you have.

feats.name: Storm Touched
feats.excerpt: Int or Wis +1 (max 20). Thunderwave always prepared, once per Long Rest without a slot.
feats.text:
Lightning answers you.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

**Thunder Step.** You always have Thunderwave prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain that use when you finish a Long Rest. Its spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

feats.name: Shieldwall
feats.excerpt: +1 Armor Class while wearing Medium or Heavy armor.
feats.text: While you are wearing Medium or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

feats.name: Boon of the Tempest
feats.excerpt: One ability score +1 (max 30). Resistance to Lightning and Thunder damage.
feats.text:
The storm is yours.

**Ability Score Increase.** Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

**Eye of the Storm.** You have Resistance to Lightning and Thunder damage.
